reuse.why: Registers Fintegra through the existing refuseIfBankAccountLinked wrapper and extracts the shared link flow (linkBankSyncAccount/finishBankSyncLink) and download (downloadBankSyncTransactions) that the existing providers now also use.

duplication.why: Instead of adding a fifth copy, it collapses the SimpleFin/Pluggy/Akahu/EnableBanking link bodies and the Pluggy/Akahu downloaders into shared functions; each provider is now a thin adapter passing its bank id, sync source and headers.

placement.why: Shared link logic stays in accounts/app.ts and the downloader in sync.ts, beside the provider dispatch in syncAccount.

scope.why: Refactors four existing providers' link functions and two downloaders, a sizable rewrite beyond adding Fintegra (and it quietly aligns Akahu's sync-event tables), plus client map entries.

maintainability.why: Adding a provider is now a few lines and the parameters (provider, bankId, fileId, extraHeaders) match real variation; the broad refactor raises review risk but leaves a cleaner design.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Fintegra goes through refuseIfBankAccountLinked, linkBankSyncAccount and downloadBankSyncTransactions.

disguised_duplication.where: Duplicated provider bodies were removed and shared, not reshaped.
